rationale: wu_2015-claude-agentic: wu_n_bands=6, wu_n_outer=1, wu_motion_range=8, wu_motion_window=2, wu_soft_thresh=0.0007, val_n=200, val_chunk=4, seed=42, rationale=ITER-7 (one knob vs iter-5 best). NUMBERS soft_thresh at n_outer=1: 0.0015->RMSE0.005580(iter-5 BEST), 0.003->0.005646(iter-6 worse). Heavier thresh removed genuine residual detail -> optimum thresh is AT or BELOW 0.0015. FAILURE MODE: the single residual pass RMSE (0.00558) sits 7pct above the 0.00521 baseline; over-thresholding discards true structure. ONE KNOB: wu_soft_thresh 0.0015 -> 0.0007 (LIGHTER, ~half; n_outer locked 1). HYPOTHESIS: if the single-pass residual is already a clean data-consistency correction, keeping MORE of it (lighter thresh) adds back more true aliasing-residual structure and drops RMSE below the 0.00521 baseline -> hr>0 clears for the first time; if lighter thresh instead lets residual streak-noise through (RMSE up), the optimum brackets in (0.0007,0.0015) and I bisect. Budget: ~seconds.
